stories.headline: Next Apple Vision Pro reportedly on 'life support,' may never launch
stories.subtitle: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple's next Vision Pro, codenamed N224, is on 'life support' with no guarantee it ever ships. If customers ask about a cheaper Apple headset, the honest answer is: don't hold your breath.

stories.headline: Steam Frame OLED rumor gets a reality check from Valve's own code
stories.subtitle: A closer look at Valve's code pours cold water on the Steam Frame OLED rumor: the high-res panel and the OLED identifier belong to separate projects, and neither confirms a commercial upgrade. The current Frame, from $1,059, stands as-is.

stories.headline: Sony sold 419 XR patents to Meta, raising PSVR2 questions
stories.subtitle: Sony sold 419 extended-reality patents to Meta, AppleInsider reports — raising questions about PlayStation VR2's future and what Meta gains for its own headset roadmap. A quiet deal customers may ask about if PSVR2 news slows.

stories.headline: SteamVR 2.18 out: Steam Frame streaming fixes, USB streaming for Quest
stories.subtitle: Valve's SteamVR 2.18 is out with streaming fixes for Steam Frame — fewer 'Error 17' drops, smoother frame delivery — plus wired USB streaming for Quest headsets and a new default 'Aurora' environment. Free update for all SteamVR headsets.

stories.headline: Correction: Steam Link on Vision Pro streams flat games only
stories.subtitle: Valve's Vision Pro app is a TestFlight beta for 2D Steam games in a resizable window — not PC VR, and not Half-Life: Alyx in VR, per Valve's own announcement and an Oct. 23 correction. Don't let customers buy a Vision Pro expecting a PC VR headset.
